The report highlighted that an agreement reached at last year's climate summit in Brazil to triple adaptation finance to $120 billion a year by 2035 would still leave a deficit of more than two-thirds, as actual needs are projected to reach $420 billion annually by 2035. Inger Andersen, executive director of the UN Environment Programme, stated that the world remains unprepared to handle current climatic conditions or the consequences of surpassing the 1.5 C limit.

This funding shortfall matters because developing nations bear the brunt of climate disasters despite contributing the least to global emissions. Without adequate financial flows from multilateral banks and wealthier nations, vulnerable populations face severe risks to food security, safety, and economic stability as global temperatures continue to rise.

stories.title: Spanish Transport Minister Resigns After Two High-Speed Train Crashes
stories.summary:
Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez announced on Wednesday that Deputy Carlos Cuerpo will temporarily take over the Transport Ministry. This comes after Oscar Puente stepped down from the role following two fatal high-speed train accidents this year that have collectively killed 115 people. Puente submitted his resignation on Tuesday evening after facing a rigorous four-hour questioning by lawmakers in a caretaker parliament body, where representatives from multiple parties held him accountable for the rail disasters.

During a brief televised address, Sanchez commended Puente for his political dignity, stating that the resignation helps restore public trust in the national rail network. Independent analyst Eduardo Bayon noted that Puente's departure shifts the political focus from assigning blame to implementing necessary safety and investment measures. Puente, a prominent and loyal minister who took office in November 2023, had initially vowed to stay on to oversee the investigation into the most recent crash in Urda, which resulted in at least 68 deaths.

Despite facing ongoing criticism from unions and opposition parties over perceived underinvestment and maintenance issues—including a Senate resignation motion in February—Puente maintained a pugnacious public style. He revealed that he decided to resign immediately after the Urda accident, informing only his family beforehand. The resignation will take official effect once published in the state gazette, and Puente has confirmed he will not run as a candidate in the upcoming November 29 election.

The ruling Socialists are now navigating an election campaign without one of their most prominent figures, while facing the People’s Party (PP), whose leader Alberto Nunez Feijoo responded to the news by suggesting Sanchez should also step down. Polls following last week's tragedy indicate a slight dip in support for the Socialists, who originally aimed to campaign on social services and housing reform.

stories.title: سندھ حکومت کا 9 نومبر کو یوم اقبال پر عام تعطیل کا اعلان
stories.summary:
حکومت سندھ نے یوم علامہ اقبال کے موقع پر 9 نومبر 2026 کو پیر کے روز صوبے بھر میں عام تعطیل کا باضابطہ اعلان کر دیا ہے۔ اس حوالے سے جاری کردہ نوٹیفکیشن کے مطابق چھٹی کا اطلاق صوبے بھر کے تمام سرکاری دفاتر، خود مختار اداروں، نیم خود مختار اداروں، کارپوریشنز اور لوکل کونسلز پر ہوگا۔ تاہم اہم خدمات کے شعبوں کو اس عام تعطیل کے دائرہ کار سے باہر رکھا گیا ہے۔

یاد رہے کہ اس سے قبل وفاقی حکومت بھی ملک بھر میں یوم اقبال کے موقع پر عام تعطیل کا اعلان کر چکی ہے۔ صوبائی حکومت کی جانب سے یہ قدم شاعر مشرق علامہ محمد اقبال کو خراج تحسین پیش کرنے کے لیے اٹھایا گیا ہے تاکہ عوام اس دن کو قومی سطح پر منا سکیں۔

stories.title: Democratic Control of US Congress Creates Divided Government for Trump
stories.summary:
Democrats secured majorities in both chambers of the United States Congress during the midterm elections, winning 54 seats in the Senate and 224 seats in the House of Representatives. This outcome establishes a divided government as President Donald Trump enters the final two years of his term, setting up significant legislative hurdles and altering the balance of power in Washington when the new Congress convenes in January 2027.

With majorities in both houses, Democrats will assume control of key congressional committees, granting them subpoena power and the ability to launch investigations, hold hearings, and request official documents. International politics professor Scott Lucas noted that Democrats are expected to prioritize accountability inquiries, which could include examinations of Trump's stockholdings, family business dealings, accumulated wealth, and pressure on federal agencies such as the Justice Department. Lawmakers may also revisit files related to convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein and scrutinize administration officials, including Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the ongoing Iran war and Justice Department head Todd Blanche.

Although Democrats can introduce their own legislative priorities regarding health care, education, immigration, and ethics reforms, advancing these measures will prove difficult if opposed by the executive branch. Presidential vetoes require a two-thirds majority in both the House and Senate to override, meaning Democrats would need Republican votes to enact major laws over Trump's objections. However, the election results may weaken Trump's influence within the Republican Party, potentially encouraging some lawmakers to cooperate across the aisle. Furthermore, the Democratic-controlled Senate will hold authority over federal spending negotiations and the confirmation or rejection of presidential nominees for federal judgeships, cabinet positions, and ambassadorships.

stories.title: کراچی پورٹ پر 27 کروڑ کا فراڈ، پرفیومز اور کاسمیٹکس برآمد
stories.summary:
ڈائریکٹوریٹ جنرل کسٹمز ٹرانزٹ ٹریڈ کراچی نے بندرگاہ پر کارروائی کرتے ہوئے 27 کروڑ 70 لاکھ روپے مالیت کے سامان میں بڑے پیمانے پر فراڈ بے نقاب کیا ہے۔ ڈی جی ٹرانزٹ ٹریڈ عرفان جاوید کے مطابق یہ مشکوک کنسائنمنٹ ایکسپورٹ پراسیسنگ زون رسالپور بھیجا جا رہا تھا جس کی فزیکل جانچ پڑتال کے دوران اشیا کی غلط تفصیلات ظاہر کیے جانے کا انکشاف ہوا۔

درآمدکنندہ کمپنی میسرز بلومنگ بڈز انڈسٹریز نے کسٹمز ڈیکلریشن میں مصنوعی پھول، مشینری کے پرزہ جات اور اسپرے ظاہر کیے تھے، جبکہ اصل میں کنسائنمنٹ میں لوڈ سیلز، پرفیومز اور کاسمیٹکس موجود تھے۔ اس غلط بیانی اور مس ڈیکلریشن کے ذریعے 10 کروڑ 80 لاکھ روپے مالیت کی کسٹم ڈیوٹی اور ٹیکسوں کی چوری کی کوشش کی گئی۔

کسٹمز حکام نے کمپنی کا ای پی زیڈ لائسنس بھی سامان سے مطابقت نہ رکھنے کا بتایا ہے۔ ڈائریکٹوریٹ نے درآمدکنندہ کمپنی، اس کے مبینہ ساتھیوں اور سہولت کاروں کے خلاف مقدمہ درج کر کے ملوث عناصر کے خلاف کنٹراوینشن کی کارروائی کا آغاز کر دیا ہے۔

stories.title: Copper Recovers From Three-Month Low Amid Strong Demand and Shortages
stories.summary:
Copper prices bounced back from a three-month low on Wednesday, driven by solid demand and supply deficits outside of the United States. Benchmark three-month copper on the London Metal Exchange increased by 0.5% to reach $14,103 per metric ton by 1115 GMT, recovering from an earlier drop of up to 1.5% to its lowest level since August 3.

The initial market slump was a sudden reaction to United States election results on Tuesday, which showed Democrats taking control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate. Saxo Bank head of commodity strategy Ole Hansen noted that market participants initially worried copper would suffer if expectations for tariffs decreased, alongside concerns over artificial intelligence trade and data center developments.

Despite potential tariff anxieties that previously spurred metal shipments to the US and created shortages elsewhere, prices found strong support from robust demand and shortages in China, the world's top metals consumer. The Yangshan copper premium stayed near $200 a ton, marking its highest point in over ten years. Additionally, a broader recovery in global stock markets and a declining dollar index provided further momentum by making dollar-priced commodities cheaper for international buyers.

Other industrial metals also posted gains during the session. Aluminium climbed 1% to $3,075 a ton, zinc increased 1.3% to $3,839, lead grew 0.3% to $1,890, nickel advanced 2.2% to $15,685, and tin rose 0.9% to $47,850.

stories.title: کراچی میں اساتذہ کا احتجاج، وزیراعلیٰ ہاؤس جانے پر پولیس کا تشدد
stories.summary:
سندھ بھر سے آئے پرائمری اسکول اساتذہ نے اپنے چودہ مطالبات کے حق میں کراچی پریس کلب کے باہر شدید احتجاج ریکارڈ کرایا اور ریلی کی شکل میں وزیراعلیٰ ہاؤس کی جانب پیش قدمی کی کوشش کی۔ پولیس نے ریڈ زون میں داخلے کی کوشش ناکام بناتے ہوئے مظاہرین پر لاٹھی چارج، شیلنگ اور واٹر کینن کا استعمال کیا، جس کے نتیجے میں کئی اساتذہ زخمی ہو گئے اور آل سندھ پرائمری ٹیچرز ایسوسی ایشن کے مرکزی صدر اعجاز علی چانڈیو سمیت متعدد افراد کو حراست میں لے لیا گیا۔ بعد ازاں حراست میں لیے جانے والے تمام مظاہرین کو رہا کر دیا گیا۔

مظاہرین میں حیدرآباد، میرپورخاص، جیکب آباد، سکھر اور دیگر اضلاع کے اساتذہ شامل تھے۔ اساتذہ کا کہنا تھا کہ وہ اگست سے تحریک چلا رہے ہیں اور ان کا احتجاج اچانک نہیں ہے۔ ان کے اہم مطالبات میں پرائمری اساتذہ کے لیے سروس اسٹرکچر کی بحالی، ابتدائی تقرری کی تاریخ سے ملازمت کا شمار، تبادلوں اور بائیومیٹرک کا نظام ضلعی سطح پر کرنا، اور اسکولوں کو ضم کرنے والی کلسٹر حب پالیسی کا خاتمہ شامل ہے۔

مظاہرین نے اس بات پر بھی زور دیا کہ چھوٹے پرائمری اسکولوں کی انفرادی حیثیت بحال رکھی جائے اور اساتذہ کو ترقی کے مناسب مواقع فراہم کیے جائیں۔ وکلاء کی جانب سے اساتذہ کو مکمل تعاون کی یقین دہانی کرائی گئی ہے، اور قیادت نے واضح کیا ہے کہ مطالبات کی منظوری تک احتجاجی سلسلہ جاری رہے گا۔

stories.title: انڈیا کا بحری بیڑے کی توسیع کیلئے پانچ ارب ڈالر کا بڑا معاہدہ
stories.summary:
انڈین وزارتِ دفاع نے ملک کے بحری بیڑے کو مزید طاقتور بنانے کے لیے پانچ ارب ڈالر سے زائد مالیت کے ایک بڑے معاہدے پر دستخط کیے ہیں۔ اس معاہدے کے تحت انڈین بحریہ میں آٹھ جدید ترین ’نیکسٹ جنریشن کارویٹ‘ جنگی جہاز شامل کیے جائیں گے۔ ان جہازوں کی تیاری کے لیے انڈیا کی دو معروف سرکاری دفاعی کمپنیوں گارڈن ریچ شپ بلڈرز اینڈ انجینئرز کولکتہ اور گوا شپ یارڈ کا انتخاب کیا گیا ہے۔

یہ درمیانی رینج کے دو سے چار ہزار ٹن وزنی تیز رفتار جنگی جہاز ہوں گے جنہیں بحرِ ہند کے خطے میں ابھرتے ہوئے اسٹریٹیجک خطرات کا مقابلہ کرنے اور بحریہ کی توسیعی ضرورتوں کو پورا کرنے کے لیے تیار کیا جا رہا ہے۔ اس منصوبے کی منظوری 28 اکتوبر کو وزیر اعظم نریندر مودی کی زیر صدارت سلامتی سے متعلق کابینہ کی کمیٹی کے اجلاس میں دی گئی تھی۔ انڈین نیوی کے تخمینے کے مطابق اس سلسلے کا پہلا جہاز سال 2030 تک بحریہ کے بیڑے کا حصہ بن جائے گا۔

دفاعی ماہرین کے مطابق کارویٹ جہاز سائز میں چھوٹے اور بڑے بحری جہازوں کے مقابلے میں زیادہ تیز رفتار ہوتے ہیں۔ یہ جدید ہتھیاروں اور ریڈار سسٹمز سے لیس ہوتے ہیں جو دشمن کی سرگرمیوں پر گہری نظر رکھنے اور ساحلی علاقوں سے دو سے تین سو میل دور سمندر میں نگرانی کرنے کی صلاحیت رکھتے ہیں۔ اس اقدام کا مقصد انڈیا کے تقریباً سات ہزار کلومیٹر طویل ساحلی خطے کا دفاع کرنا اور سمندری تجارت کے اہم راستوں کا تحفظ یقینی بنانا ہے۔

stories.title: خیبرپختونخوا پولیس کا دہشتگردی سے متاثرہ اضلاع کیلئے 40 ارب کا مطالبہ
stories.summary:
خیبرپختونخوا میں دہشت گردی کے بڑھتے ہوئے خطرات اور پولیس اہلکاروں پر حملوں کے پیش نظر صوبائی پولیس نے سیکیورٹی کے نظام کو جدید خطوط پر استوار کرنے کے لیے وفاقی حکومت سے 40 ارب روپے کے خصوصی پیکج کا مطالبہ کیا ہے۔ دہشت گردی سے متاثرہ 12 اضلاع میں پولیس کی استعداد کار بڑھانے، انہیں جدید ٹیکنالوجی، اسلحے، حفاظتی آلات اور بلٹ پروف گاڑیوں سے لیس کرنے کے لیے ایک جامع ماسٹر سیکیورٹی پلان تیار کر کے وفاق کو بھجوایا گیا ہے۔

آئی جی خیبرپختونخوا پولیس ذوالفقار حمید کے مطابق اس منصوبے کو چار کیٹیگریز میں تقسیم کیا گیا ہے، جن میں پولیس کی استعداد کار میں اضافہ، جدید سازوسامان کی فراہمی، انفرا اسٹرکچر کی بہتری اور فورس کی تربیت شامل ہیں۔ ذرائع کا کہنا ہے کہ اس ضمن میں وفاقی حکومت نے پولیس اور سیکیورٹی انفرا اسٹرکچر کی بہتری کے لیے 21 ارب روپے فراہم کرنے پر رضامندی ظاہر کر دی ہے۔

stories.title: West Ham Appoints Scott Parker as Manager After Dismissing Nuno
stories.summary:
West Ham United officially named Scott Parker as their new manager on Wednesday, following the dismissal of Nuno Espirito Santo. The 46-year-old former England midfielder previously played four seasons for the east London club and has a managerial track record that includes leading both Bournemouth and Burnley to promotion from the Championship, as well as managing Fulham and Club Brugge.

Parker signed a two-and-a-half-year contract and expressed immense pride in returning to a place that holds significant personal meaning. He takes over the squad immediately ahead of their upcoming away match against Cardiff on Wednesday. Interim chief executive Karim Virani stated that Parker was the unanimous choice of the board due to the high regard he commands at the club and throughout football.

Nuno, aged 52, was sacked on Tuesday after leading the team through their Premier League relegation last season and remaining in charge to pursue an immediate top-flight return. Although anticipated by many to secure automatic promotion, West Ham currently sits eighth in the second-tier standings, trailing league leaders Middlesbrough by six points after 13 matches.

Parker becomes West Ham's fourth permanent manager since David Moyes departed in May 2024, succeeding short-tenured bosses Julen Lopetegui and Graham Potter. Confident in his ability to revive the club's promotion campaign, Parker emphasized his prior experience of achieving promotion from the division three times.

stories.title: Israeli President Receives Final Election Results Amid Rejected Fraud Claims
stories.summary:
Israeli President Isaac Herzog was presented with the official results of the nation's parliamentary elections on Wednesday during a ceremony in Jerusalem. The handover coincided with the Central Elections Committee formally rejecting fraud allegations raised by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and allied right-wing parties regarding voting within the Arab community.

During the event, Committee Chairman Judge Noam Sohlberg cautioned against actions aimed at discrediting the electoral outcome, describing such efforts as a dangerous threat to democracy. Sohlberg stressed that the final results are binding on all citizens and explicitly warned against casting doubt on the legitimacy of votes cast by Arab voters, maintaining that no single segment of Israeli society should be unfairly targeted. The committee approved the final vote count with 15 members voting in favor, two opposed, and 14 abstaining, after concluding there was no evidence that the integrity of the election had been compromised.

Following the delivery of the results, President Herzog began consultations with representatives from elected political parties to determine which lawmaker is best positioned to assemble a governing coalition. Parties are expected to recommend candidates for the prime minister role, with Yair Lapid's Yashar expected to secure 48 recommendations alongside partner factions, while Netanyahu anticipates 46 recommendations from his right-wing bloc. Predominantly Arab parties, including the Joint List and Ra'am, alongside the ultra-Orthodox United Torah Judaism party, have yet to announce their candidate endorsements.

stories.title: Traffic Diverted Around Karachi Press Club Due to Teacher Protest
stories.summary:
Traffic police in Karachi closed several roads surrounding the Karachi Press Club on Wednesday due to a demonstration staged in the area. The closures impacted M.R. Kiyani Road leading towards Fawara Chowk, Din Muhammad Wafai Road, and Sarwar Shaheed Road from the Coast Guard Officers’ Mess toward Angle Chowk.

Authorities advised commuters to utilize alternative routes to bypass the disruptions. Recommended detours included Thana Gali, Aiwan-i-Sadr Road, Zainab Market, and the passport office road.

The demonstration was organized by a primary teachers' association at the press club. According to reports, the protesting group intended to march toward the Chief Minister’s House.

Road closures around key civic and political hubs frequently impact urban mobility during labor and professional demonstrations in Karachi. The traffic police continued to monitor the situation and manage alternative thoroughfares while the protest was underway.

stories.title: Pakistan Announces Squad for Upcoming AFC Under-17 Asian Cup Qualifiers
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Football Federation has officially released a 23-member roster representing the country for the upcoming AFC Under-17 Asian Cup 2027 qualifiers. Scheduled to take place in Laos, the continental fixtures will run from November 8 through November 20. The announcement follows the completion of the PFF National Under-17 Football Championship 2026, a domestic tournament designed to scout and highlight emerging talent from all over the nation.

Under the leadership of head coach Mohammad Habib, the young squad has been placed in Group D for the regional tournament. During this phase of the competition, the team will compete against Jordan, Iran, Sri Lanka, and the host nation Laos. The young athletes are preparing to use the experience gained from the domestic championship to help secure a spot in the primary continental tournament.

The selected group of players comprises three goalkeepers, eleven defenders, eight midfielders, and five forwards. The goalkeepers named in the lineup are Samar Razzaq, Wali Ullah, and Ahsan Ullah. Meanwhile, the defensive responsibilities will be handled by Nadeem Hussain, Hamza Khan, Muhammad Hammad, Syed Manzar Shah, Mubashir Shah, Muhammad Awais, Hasnain Ali, and Mohsin Amin.

The midfield department features Abdul Sammad, Arsalan Fareedi, Muhammad Khalil Ullah, Muhammad Irmad Sarwar, Muhammad Anees, Bari Dad, and Essa Khan. Completing the 23-player roster, the forward line consists of Muhammad Raffy, Muhammad Moosa, Muhammad Shahzad, Hazrat Abbas, and Haris Khan as the team prepares for its upcoming matches in Laos.

stories.title: Pakistani Rupee Edges Up Against US Dollar in Inter-Bank Market
stories.summary:
The Pakistani rupee registered a marginal increase against the US dollar in the inter-bank market on Wednesday. The local currency finished the trading day at 276.70 against the greenback, marking a slight gain of Re0.01 compared to the previous day's close of 276.71.

Internationally, the US dollar retreated against a majority of major currencies as investors monitored early results from the United States midterm elections and anticipated potential Democratic gains. Early returns included Democratic Senator Jon Ossoff winning reelection in Georgia, while broader control of Congress remained undecided.

Currency benchmarks showed the euro rising 0.2% to $1.1212 and the yen strengthening to 158.30 per US dollar. Meanwhile, the dollar index decreased by 0.2% to 101.7, and the yield on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury note dropped 4 basis points to 4.919%.

Oil prices also experienced volatility during the session as markets awaited developments regarding the US-Israeli conflict involving Iran following the Democratic capture of Congress. Brent futures advanced 76 cents to $104.36 a barrel, and US West Texas Intermediate crude futures increased by 63 cents to $96.72.

stories.title: Sri Lankan Shares Climb as Financial Stocks Drive Market Gains
stories.summary:
Sri Lankan equities finished higher on Wednesday, propelled largely by gains within the financial sector at the Colombo Stock Exchange. The CSE All-Share index advanced by 2.09 percent to conclude the session at 20,541.12 points. Key contributors to this upward movement included Commercial Bank of Ceylon PLC, which increased by 1.8 percent, Dialog Axiata PLC, which rose by 2.5 percent, and Hatton National Bank PLC, which climbed 1.9 percent.

Trading activity expanded considerably during the session. Overall trading volume on the index grew to 119.5 million shares, an increase from the 61.9 million shares recorded in the preceding session. Furthermore, the market turnover climbed to 3.87 billion Sri Lankan rupees, equivalent to roughly $11.64 million, compared to 1.52 billion rupees in the previous trading day according to data provided by the exchange.

Market participation showed a divergence between foreign and domestic investors. Foreign investors operated as net sellers, disposing of equities valued at 158.8 million rupees. Conversely, domestic investors acted as net buyers, acquiring shares with a total value of 3.84 billion rupees during the trading day.

This mid-week surge highlights a strong domestic interest in Sri Lankan equities, particularly within banking and telecommunications heavyweights. The significant expansion in both share volume and monetary turnover underscores heightened trading momentum on the Colombo bourse as financial institutions led the broader market index upward.

stories.title: Malaysian Palm Oil Drops to Four-Month Low on Stockpiles
stories.summary:
Malaysian palm oil futures experienced a third consecutive session of losses on Wednesday, tumbling to a four-month low. The market downward pressure stemmed from forecasts pointing toward record-high inventories alongside weaker pricing for competing edible oils like Dalian palm olein. The benchmark January delivery contract on the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange dropped 55 ringgit, representing a 1.21 percent decrease, to close at 4,496 ringgit, or roughly $1,104.67 per metric ton. This marked the lowest closing level recorded since July 3.

The bearish market sentiment persisted following polling data released on Tuesday indicating that end-month palm oil stocks likely achieved record volumes in October. A Reuters survey projected that Malaysia's palm oil inventories expanded by 6.8 percent from the September record of 3.51 million tons, pushing total stockpiles to an estimated 3.75 million tons.

Additional negative momentum arrived from overnight weakness in Dalian palm olein, which was partly influenced by falling crude palm oil futures. Dalian's most-active soyoil contract decreased by 1.45 percent, its palm oil contract fell by 2.91 percent, and Chicago Board of Trade soyoil prices declined by 0.64 percent. Because palm oil competes directly for market share in the global vegetable oil sector, it closely tracks alternative edible oil prices.

Meanwhile, crude oil prices advanced amidst a volatile trading session as market participants monitored Washington's response to the US-Israeli conflict involving Iran, following Democratic victories in US midterm elections that shifted control of Congress from President Donald Trump's Republican party. Higher crude prices typically improve the appeal of palm oil as biodiesel feedstock. Simultaneously, the Malaysian ringgit appreciated by 0.34 percent against the dollar, raising acquisition costs for foreign currency holders.

stories.title: Indian Shares Achieve Longest Winning Streak in Five Months
stories.summary:
Indian benchmark equities registered their longest winning streak in nearly five months on Wednesday, driven by optimism regarding foreign portfolio investments. Investors also closely monitored US midterm election results, which are poised to alter the political dynamic of the United States. A Democratic victory is interpreted as a rebuke of President Donald Trump, whose administration faced scrutiny for global tariff implementations and Middle Eastern military actions that previously weighed on Indian market performance.

India is presently engaged in trade negotiations with the US, while the Trump administration has enforced restrictions on Indian talent through curbs on H-1B and student visas. Nabil Milali, a multi-asset portfolio manager at Edmond de Rothschild AM, noted that the Democratic victory does not guarantee the implementation of their legislative agenda since the US President retains veto power over opposing legislation. The Nifty 50 advanced 0.63 percent to reach 23,960.6, while the BSE Sensex gained 0.5 percent to settle at 77,301.4, accumulating a gain of roughly 5.6 percent across five sessions.

Foreign investors acquired $821 million worth of Indian shares since November began, reducing their net yearly outflows to $30.59 billion. Most major sectors experienced gains, with small-caps and mid-caps expanding by 2 percent and 1.6 percent, respectively. However, the Nifty IT index fell 1.5 percent, led by software exporters Tata Consultancy Services and Infosys dropping 2.5 percent and 1.7 percent. Analysts suggested this selling reflected caution regarding potential AI spending slowdowns under a changing US political landscape and profit-taking after strong prior gains.

Simultaneously, Brent crude futures declined 1 percent to $102.5 per barrel as market observers awaited Washington's next actions concerning the US-Israeli war on Iran.

stories.title: Indonesia Deploys Troops as President Sacks Chief of Staff Over Wiretapping
stories.summary:
Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto dismissed his newly appointed chief of staff, Listyo Sigit Prabowo, on Wednesday following his arrest in connection with a major illegal wiretapping scandal. The government asserted that the covert surveillance activities pointed toward potential acts of treason against the state.

Listyo, a former national police chief and loyalist to former President Widodo, was detained alongside two other senior police officers. Authorities stated the suspects had been illegally tapping the phones of President Prabowo, journalists, politicians, government officials, and business leaders since early 2025. Presidential spokesperson Prasetyo Hadi described the actions as endangering state interests and national leadership safety.

In response to the escalating political crisis, the Indonesian military deployed thousands of troops to the capital of Jakarta. Navy spokesperson Tunggul stated that the forces were mobilized to safeguard national security and stability, amid growing concerns over potential friction between police loyal to the detained chief and military elements supporting the president.

The scandal compounds challenges for President Prabowo, who has faced sliding approval ratings, public discontent over populist policies, and investor scrutiny over economic management. Political allies and international organizations have called for transparency regarding the targets and motives behind the wiretaps, as the ruling party initiates talks with other political groups.

stories.title: پاکستان ایل این جی لمیٹڈ نے دو اسپاٹ کارگوز کی خریداری کا ٹینڈر جاری کردیا
stories.summary:
پاکستان ایل این جی لمیٹڈ (پی ایل ایل) کی جانب سے لیکویفائیڈ نیچرل گیس (ایل این جی) کے دو اسپاٹ کارگوز کی خریداری کے لیے باضابطہ ٹینڈر جاری کر دیے گئے ہیں۔ یہ ٹینڈرز اسلام آباد سے جاری کیے گئے ہیں جن کا مقصد ملک میں گیس کی طلب کو پورا کرنا اور توانائی کی ترسیل کو بہتر بنانا ہے۔

پی ایل ایل کے جاری کردہ اعلامیے کے مطابق یہ ٹینڈرز رواں سال کے آخری مہینے یعنی دسمبر اور اگلے سال کے پہلے مہینے یعنی جنوری کی سپلائی کے لیے منگوائے گئے ہیں۔ اس حوالے سے دنیا بھر کے عالمی سپلائرز کو چھ نومبر تک اپنی بولیاں جمع کرانے کی دعوت دی گئی ہے۔

اعلامیے میں مزید بتایا گیا ہے کہ سپلائرز کی جانب سے موصول ہونے والی تمام بڈز چھ نومبر کو ہی کھولی جائیں گی۔ طے شدہ شیڈول کے مطابق پہلے کارگو کی ترسیل چودہ سے سولہ دسمبر کے دوران کی جائے گی جبکہ دوسرے کارگو کی ڈلیوری نو سے گیارہ جنوری کے درمیان متوقع ہے۔

stories.title: سوات: مہوڈنڈ کے مقام سے دریائے سوات سے خاتون کی لاش برآمد
stories.summary:
ریسکیو حکام نے دریائے سوات سے مہوڈنڈ کے مقام سے ایک نامعلوم خاتون کی لاش برآمد کر لی ہے۔ لاش ملنے کے بعد اسے فوری طور پر کالام سے مدین اسپتال منتقل کر دیا گیا ہے جہاں اس کی ضروری کارروائی کی جا رہی ہے۔

ریسکیو ذرائع کا کہنا ہے کہ یہ برآمد ہونے والی لاش یکم جولائی کو سیف اللہ جھیل میں پیش آنے والے کشتی حادثے میں لاپتہ ہونے والی خاتون بشریٰ کی ہو سکتی ہے۔ تاہم حتمی طور پر کچھ بھی کہنا قبل از وقت ہے اور لاش کی درست شناخت میڈیکل رپورٹ آنے کے بعد ہی ممکن ہو سکے گی۔

واضح رہے کہ یکم جولائی کو سیف اللہ جھیل میں ایک کشتی الٹنے کے حادثے میں کل نو افراد ڈوب گئے تھے جن میں سے دو افراد کو بحفاظت بچا لیا گیا تھا جبکہ چھ افراد کی لاشیں پہلے نکالی جا چکی تھیں۔ اس المناک حادثے کا شکار ہونے والے متاثرہ خاندان کا تعلق لاہور سے تھا۔

stories.title: سندھ لوکل گورنمنٹ ترمیمی ایکٹ 2026 کا نوٹیفکیشن جاری
stories.summary:
سندھ لوکل گورنمنٹ ترمیمی ایکٹ 2026 کا باضابطہ نوٹیفکیشن جاری کر دیا گیا ہے، جسے محکمہ بلدیات نے تمام متعلقہ بلدیاتی اداروں کو ارسال کر دیا ہے۔ سندھ اسمبلی نے اس ترمیمی ایکٹ کی منظوری 14 ستمبر کو دی تھی، اور اب اس کی نقل تمام میئرز، میونسپل کمشنرز اور ٹاؤن چیئرمینز کو بھیج دی گئی ہے۔

تمام بلدیاتی اداروں کو ہدایت کی گئی ہے کہ وہ اس ترمیمی ایکٹ کی دفعات پر سختی سے عمل درآمد کریں۔ نئے قواعد کے مطابق، بلدیاتی کونسل کی مدت پوری ہونے پر موجودہ میئر نئے میئر کے حلف اٹھانے تک بطور ایڈمنسٹریٹر اپنے فرائض انجام دیتے رہیں گے اور اپنے اختیارات استعمال کریں گے۔

اسی طرح، موجودہ ٹاؤن چیئرمین بھی نئے چیئرمین کے عہدہ سنبھالنے تک بطور ایڈمنسٹریٹر کام جاری رکھیں گے اور اپنے اختیارات استعمال کرتے رہیں گے۔ اس اقدام کا مقصد بلدیاتی امور کی روانی کو برقرار رکھنا اور مدت ختم ہونے کے بعد پیدا ہونے والے انتظامی تعطل کو روکنا ہے۔

اس کے علاوہ محکمہ بلدیات نے متعلقہ حکام کو ہدایت کی ہے کہ وہ اس ایکٹ کی تمام ہدایات پر فوری عمل درآمد یقینی بنائیں۔ یہ ترامیم سندھ بھر کے مقامی حکومتوں کے نظام میں تسلسل اور بہتری لانے کے لیے متعارف کروائی گئی ہیں تاکہ عوامی کام بلا تعطل جاری رہ سکیں۔

stories.title: PM Youth Programme and ICE Sign Deal for Scholarships
stories.summary:
The Prime Minister’s Youth Programme (PMYP) in Pakistan signed a Letter of Intent with the International College of Excellence (ICE) Pakistan to expand access to higher education, professional training, and skills enhancement for young citizens. The high-level ceremony took place at the Prime Minister’s Office in Islamabad and was chaired by PMYP Chairman Rana Mashhood Ahmad Khan, alongside ICE Chief Executive Officer Usman Akram, PMYP Director General Dr. Syed Shahbaz Shamsi, and various institutional representatives.

The International College of Excellence operates as a Transnational Education provider, delivering foundation, undergraduate, and postgraduate credentials in collaboration with prominent UK universities and awarding bodies. The Prime Minister’s Youth Programme functions as a government initiative centered on youth empowerment through its 4Es framework encompassing education, employment, engagement, and environment.

Under the terms of the collaboration, merit-based scholarships will be distributed to talented and deserving students and educators, granting them access to internationally recognized qualifications and professional development. These scholarships will fund 100 percent of tuition fees for the standard duration of the programs, with recipients chosen via a transparent selection procedure. Furthermore, the partnership encompasses cooperative efforts in career counseling, skill development, internships, international academic programming, and teacher training.

Chairman Rana Mashhood Ahmad Khan praised the agreement for providing young Pakistanis with essential educational tools and professional skills to aid national development. CEO Usman Akram highlighted ICE's dedication to empowering students through international education and merit-based financial support. Ultimately, the alliance reinforces both organizations' shared dedication to youth empowerment and human capital development across Pakistan.

stories.title: Iran and US Remain Divided as Regional Tensions Persist
stories.summary:
Iran and the United States continue to experience significant distance regarding a potential deal to conclude their ongoing conflict, according to a senior Iranian official. The situation coincides with US President Donald Trump declining to rule out future combat operations following midterm elections, even as mediator Qatar intensifies diplomatic efforts to prevent a renewed escalation in the region.

Overnight, American forces executed defensive strikes on Iran's Qeshm island, targeting surface-to-air missiles used against US assets. While US officials characterized the military action as limited and not signaling a return to major combat operations, Tehran warned of a forceful response. Iranian officials stressed that nuclear talks cannot begin, and the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen, until Washington fully and explicitly addresses Iran's seven conditions, which include waiving oil sanctions, ending the naval blockade, and releasing frozen funds.

Simultaneously, regional diplomacy is advancing through various channels. Qatari mediators have traveled to Tehran to review draft proposals and narrow the gaps between Washington and Tehran. Additionally, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi confirmed that ongoing talks with Saudi Arabia seek new regional security arrangements excluding foreign military involvement, while Yemen's Houthis have stepped up attacks on Saudi Arabia.

President Trump indicated in interviews that indirect negotiations concerning enriched uranium stockpiles are ongoing, noting readiness for military action if necessary while also announcing a separate deal with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to alter annual funding while continuing arms sales. As investors monitor the diplomatic and military developments, Iranian leaders assert that any US miscalculation will be met with an unpredictable and geographically unconstrained response.

stories.title: Pakistan Seeks Turkish Support to Expand Agricultural Exports
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Commerce Jam Kamal Khan met with Türkiye’s Minister of Trade, Prof. Dr. Ömer Bolat, on the sidelines of the 42nd Session of the Standing Committee for Economic and Commercial Cooperation in Istanbul. During the bilateral discussions, Jam Kamal Khan highlighted Pakistan's agricultural export potential and requested Turkish assistance in facilitating market access to increase exports of Pakistani mangoes.

The Turkish trade minister assured full support for increasing mango imports and expanding agricultural trade. Both officials reaffirmed their commitment to strengthening bilateral economic ties. Jam Kamal Khan also expressed appreciation for Türkiye’s support regarding Pakistan's claims on Basmati rice, while Prof. Dr. Ömer Bolat emphasized the importance of effective marketing and branding to enhance consumer recognition for the product in Türkiye. In response to the talks, the Turkish minister agreed to send a delegation of officials to Pakistan to review existing trade mechanisms.

Additionally, the Pakistani commerce minister highlighted investment opportunities for Turkish enterprises, drawing attention to 1,000 acres of land earmarked at the Karachi Industrial Park for industrial units. He invited Turkish businesses to establish manufacturing footprints and expand their investments within the country.

Separately, Jam Kamal Khan held discussions with Zehra Zümrüt Selçuk, Director General of the Statistical, Economic and Social Research and Training Centre for Islamic Countries. The meeting focused on OIC research initiatives, trade reports, and the critical importance of reliable statistical data and evidence-based assessments in identifying emerging trade trends and enhancing economic integration among member states.

stories.title: Sindh Announces Province-Wide School Closure for Iqbal Day
stories.summary:
The government of Sindh has officially announced that all public and private educational institutions across the province will remain closed on Monday, November 9. The closure is designated to mark the birth anniversary of Dr. Allama Muhammad Iqbal, recognized as Pakistan's national poet, philosopher, and ideological founder.

The decision was communicated through a notification issued by the School Education and Literacy Department and shared via the social media platform X. According to the department, the closure follows a directive established during a meeting of the Steering Committee on Education held earlier in the year on February 12. Copies of the notification were sent to senior officials, including the principal secretaries of the Sindh governor and chief minister.

Born in Sialkot on November 9, 1877, Dr. Allama Muhammad Iqbal played a pivotal role in the nation's history. During the 1930 Allahabad session of the Muslim League, he became the first politician to articulate the two-nation theory, which eventually led to the creation of Pakistan on August 14, 1947.

Iqbal Day remained a national public holiday for decades until the federal interior ministry cancelled the annual designation via a circular in November 2015 without providing a specific reason. However, the holiday was subsequently restored in 2022 under the administration of Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif.

stories.title: Imran Khan in Good Health at Adiala Jail Despite Wife's Eye Issue
stories.summary:
Imran Khan, the incarcerated former prime minister of Pakistan, was reported to be in satisfactory health during a meeting with his lawyer at Adiala Jail on Monday. According to sources, the session was restricted strictly to professional and legal matters in adherence to an agreement prohibiting political discussions, though the ex-premier remained well-informed about outside political changes.

During the visit, the former premier demonstrated awareness of recent federal emergency measures and the enactment of governor’s rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. These ongoing political developments have generated significant questions regarding the future direction and strategy of the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf party within the province, where it previously held governing power.

Despite his own stable condition, Imran Khan expressed deep worry regarding an eye-related medical problem affecting Bushra Bibi. In response to her situation, he advised that legal counsel pursue formal relief through appropriate judicial forums and standard court mechanisms to secure assistance in accordance with the law.

This legal consultation occurs amid an environment of heightened political friction stemming from the federal government's recent interventions in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The meeting marks a notable communication link between the jailed leader and his legal representatives as the party navigates a complex political landscape.

stories.title: Iranian Officials Express Triumph as US Voters Deliver Midterm Blow to Trump
stories.summary:
Iranian officials publicly welcomed the setbacks suffered by US President Donald Trump in the midterm elections, interpreting the results as a strong voter rejection of the ongoing war. Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf posted on social media that Americans had rejected war due to conscience and the cost of living, stating that Washington should not ignore public opinion by attacking Iran again. Meanwhile, Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei warned in a written statement that US hostility would persist regardless of which political party holds power.

In Tuesday's election, Democrats captured majorities in both the Senate and the House of Representatives, fueled by widespread voter frustration over Trump's economic stewardship and the military conflict that drove up gas prices. Iranian state media and citizens celebrated the outcome, drawing parallels to historical events and noting the severe economic strain caused by the conflict, a naval blockade, and disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz since the US and Israel attacked Iran on February 28.

Despite welcoming the Democratic victory, senior Iranian sources indicated that Tehran remains on high alert for potential retaliatory military strikes by Trump. Mediators have intensified efforts to end the war amid fears of renewed combat, while Iran continues to demand lasting control over the Strait of Hormuz. Trump defended his actions on Fox News, noting that voters understood the importance of his policies regarding Iran.

The conflict has involved regional actors including Hezbollah in Lebanon and Houthi forces in Yemen striking energy facilities in Saudi Arabia, severely impacting global oil and gas markets. Iranian newspapers and citizens emphasized the historic nature of the Republican defeat, linking the congressional outcome to decades of fraught relations originating from the 1979 US embassy takeover in Tehran.

stories.title: Pakistan Trio Makes Significant Gains in Latest ICC Rankings
stories.summary:
Pakistan cricket captain Shaheen Shah Afridi, along with opener Fakhar Zaman and fast bowler Haris Rauf, has made notable progress in the latest International Cricket Council One Day International rankings released on Wednesday. The improvements follow Pakistan's performances in the recently concluded ODI tri-series against England and Sri Lanka.

Shaheen Shah Afridi climbed one spot to reach fifth place in the ODI bowling rankings with 621 rating points, finishing the tri-series as the second-highest wicket-taker with 10 scalps across five matches. Haris Rauf also advanced five places to 24th position after claiming seven wickets in five matches. Meanwhile, mystery spinner Abrar Ahmed dropped one position to fourth after missing all of Pakistan's matches in the tournament. Afghanistan's Rashid Khan maintains the top position among ODI bowlers.

In the batting rankings, Fakhar Zaman emerged as Pakistan's largest mover, jumping nine places to 37th with 548 rating points. The left-handed batter's rise was driven by a century against Sri Lanka in the tri-series final at Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore, where he scored 127 runs from 99 balls to end a three-year ODI century drought. Among other Pakistani batters, Babar Azam stayed ninth with 661 points, while Salman Ali Agha maintained 13th position. Conversely, Mohammad Rizwan fell two spots to 44th, Saim Ayub slipped four positions to joint 68th, and Shadab Khan dropped to 93rd. India's Shubman Gill retains the number one ranking among ODI batters.

stories.title: ای سی سی نے دفاعی منصوبوں اور آبی وسائل کے لیے اربوں روپے منظور کیے
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر خزانہ و ریونیو سینیٹر محمد اورنگزیب کی زیر صدارت کابینہ کی اقتصادی رابطہ کمیٹی (ای سی سی) کا اجلاس اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا، جس میں مختلف وزارتوں اور ڈویژنز کے لیے اربوں روپے کی تکنیکی ضمنی گرانٹس کی منظوری دی گئی۔ اجلاس میں وفاقی وزرا اور سینئر حکام نے شرکت کی اور گیارہ نکاتی ایجنڈے کا جائزہ لیا۔

اجلاس کے دوران دفاعی خدمات کے جاری منصوبوں کے لیے 54 ارب روپے، لائن ایج ایل ایل ہزار طیارے کی شمولیت کے لیے ایک ارب 94 کروڑ روپے اور پروجیکٹ استقلال کے لیے 29 ارب 13 کروڑ 90 لاکھ روپے کی تکنیکی ضمنی گرانٹس منظور کی گئیں۔ کمیٹی نے فرنٹیئر کور بلوچستان نارتھ کے ہیلی کاپٹروں کی دیکھ بھال کے لیے 37 لاکھ 10 ہزار روپے کی گرانٹ بھی منظور کی تاکہ ضروری آپریشنل تقاضے پورے کیے جا سکیں۔

کمیٹی نے وزیراعظم یوتھ بزنس اینڈ ایگریکلچر لون اسکیم کے بینک ریٹ میں نظرثانی کی منظوری دی تاکہ نوجوانوں کو سستے قرضے مل سکیں۔ اس کے علاوہ کفایت شعاری مہم کے نتیجے میں حاصل ہونے والی 15 ارب 62 کروڑ 50 لاکھ روپے کی بچت وزیراعظم کفایت شعاری فنڈ میں منتقل کرنے کی منظوری دی گئی۔ وزارت آبی وسائل کے اہم منصوبوں کے لیے 275 ارب روپے کی تکنیکی ضمنی گرانٹ بھی منظور کی گئی۔

ای سی سی نے وزارت تجارت کی سمری پر کیمروں سے لیس اسمارٹ چشموں کی درآمد پر پابندی عائد کرنے کی منظوری دی، اور فاطمہ فرٹ اور ایگری ٹیک کارخانوں کو رواں سال کے آخر تک گیس فراہمی جاری رکھنے کی اجازت دی۔ مالی سال کے دوران گیس پیداواری فیلڈز کے قریب دیہات کو گیس کی فراہمی کے لیے ایک ارب روپے کی تکنیکی ضمنی گرانٹ بھی منظور کی گئی۔

stories.title: Trump Attributes Midterm Election Defeat Partly to War on Iran
stories.summary:
President Donald Trump admitted on Wednesday that the ongoing military conflict with Iran contributed to his party's major losses in the midterm elections, which resulted in Democrats capturing full control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate. Speaking to Fox News and The Wall Street Journal, Trump conceded that the confrontation with Iran was a factor in the outcome. However, he defended his choice to initiate the military campaign, stating he believed it was the correct decision and would repeat the action despite previously campaigning on a promise of avoiding new conflicts.

The nine-month-old military engagement has faced widespread public disapproval from the outset. Throughout their campaigns, Democratic candidates nationwide pointed to the hostilities as a primary driver behind surging prices for gasoline and various other consumer goods. Throughout the conflict, Trump has provided inconsistent objectives and schedules, ranging from threats to escalate American military operations to assertions that he possesses the capability to conclude the fighting whenever he chooses.

The electoral outcome guarantees a contentious final two years for Trump's administration, as the Democratic landslide serves as a severe rebuke of the president and the Republican Party. By securing majorities in both congressional chambers, Democrats possess the legislative authority to obstruct Trump's political agenda and initiate investigations into suspected corruption. Voter discontent was heavily fueled by widespread frustration regarding escalating living expenses, trade tariffs, and the military campaign against Iran, which drove up fuel prices and intensified overall dissatisfaction with the president.

Meanwhile, officials in Tehran welcomed the outcome of the American elections. Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, the Speaker of the Iranian Parliament, expressed approval of the results on Wednesday through a post on the social media platform X, stating that Americans had rejected warfare and that Tehran supported that message. The sweeping Democratic victories included flipping Senate seats in at least six states, notably traditional Republican strongholds such as Texas, Kansas, and South Carolina.

stories.title: Islamabad High Court Sets Hearing for Imran and Bushra's £190m Case Appeals
stories.summary:
The Islamabad High Court has scheduled the hearing for appeals filed by Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf founder Imran Khan and his wife, Bushra Bibi, against their convictions in the £190 million case for November 10. A division bench consisting of Chief Justice Sardar Muhammad Sarfraz Dogar and Justice Muhammad Asif will preside over the proceedings to evaluate arguments from the convicts' legal counsel challenging their prison sentences.

The upcoming hearing follows a previous adjournment requested by Imran's lawyer, Barrister Salman Safdar, before the court formally took up the matter. In January 2025, an Islamabad accountability court had sentenced Imran to 14 years and Bushra to seven years in prison following a reference filed by the National Accountability Bureau.

The £190 million case centers around allegations involving the Al-Qadir Trust, a welfare organization established in 2018 that operates a university outside Islamabad. Government allegations claim the trust served as a front to receive millions of dollars in land from a real estate tycoon in exchange for the former prime minister's administration using repatriated funds from the United Kingdom to pay off the businessman's fines instead of depositing the money into the national exchequer.

Imran Khan has consistently denied all allegations of wrongdoing, maintaining that neither he nor his spouse derived any personal financial benefit from the trust or the associated financial transactions.

stories.title: امریکہ کے وسط مدتی انتخابات میں ڈیموکریٹس کی برتری، ٹرمپ کا تعاون کا اعلان
stories.summary:
امریکہ کے وسط مدتی انتخابات میں ڈیموکریٹس کے لیے حوصلہ افزا نتائج سامنے آئے ہیں اور پیش گوئی کی جا رہی ہے کہ وہ سینیٹ اور ایوانِ نمائندگان دونوں میں اکثریت حاصل کر لیں گے۔ اس صورتحال کے بعد صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ نے غیر متوقع طور پر مفاہمتی انداز اپناتے ہوئے ڈیموکریٹس کے ساتھ مل کر کام کرنے کی آمادگی ظاہر کی ہے۔

ٹرمپ نے پولیٹیکو سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ وہ ڈیموکریٹس کے ساتھ مل کر کام کریں گے تاکہ ملک کے معاملات بہتر انداز میں آگے بڑھ سکیں۔ تاہم دوسری جانب وہ اپنے صدارتی اختیارات اور ویٹو کے حق کے استعمال کے بھی اشارے دے چکے ہیں تاکہ ڈیموکریٹس کی قانون سازی میں توازن رکھا جا سکے۔

مشیگن میں عبدل السیّد سینیٹ کے لیے منتخب ہونے والے پہلے مسلمان مرد بن گئے ہیں، جسے ووٹرز نے ایک تاریخی سنگِ میل قرار دیا ہے۔ دریں اثنا، الاسکا میں سینیٹ کی ایک نشست پر مقابلہ انتہائی سخت ہے جہاں موجودہ سینیٹر ڈین سلیوان اور ڈیموکریٹ میری پیلٹولا کے درمیان مقابلہ جاری ہے، اور اس نشست پر دو ہم نام امیدواروں کی موجودگی پر عدالت میں درخواست بھی دائر کی گئی تھی۔

ایرانی پارلیمنٹ کے سپیکر محمد باقر قالیباف نے بھی امریکی انتخابات پر تبصرہ کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ امریکیوں نے جنگ کو مسترد کیا ہے۔ دریں اثنا لاس اینڈ میں میئر کے انتخاب کے لیے کیرن بیس اور نتھیا رامن کے درمیان کانٹے کا مقابلہ جاری ہے جبکہ حتمی نتائج میں کچھ وقت لگ سکتا ہے۔

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Highlights Middle East Peace Efforts and Domestic Relief
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif stated that Pakistan is maintaining its active diplomatic role in seeking peace restoration in the Middle East amidst rising international fuel prices. During a federal cabinet meeting on November 4, the premier pointed out that global oil costs had surged heavily due to regional instability, recalling recent engagements with Tehran and other regional authorities, as well as efforts tied to the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement.

Addressing domestic economic pressures, PM Shehbaz mentioned that a planned Rs15 fuel price hike scheduled for Friday was averted after Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik engaged with local refineries to absorb the cost through their windfall profits, ensuring ordinary citizens are protected from the burden. He added that the fuel subsidy initiative, rolled out in September, will remain active until the end of December, noting that Rs28 billion has been spent transparently under Intelligence Bureau monitoring.

Regarding the liquefied petroleum gas sector, the prime minister declared that the influence of the LPG mafia has ended through transparent importation, competitive lot auctions, and consumer subsidies. Furthermore, he announced a finalized Rs160 billion development and security package for Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, emphasizing that counterterrorism remains a paramount priority alongside winter energy preparations despite maritime route disruptions.

The measures are vital for maintaining economic stability, ensuring public welfare, and addressing regional security concerns as Pakistan navigates complex geopolitical and domestic challenges.

stories.title: پبلک اکاؤنٹس کمیٹی کا وزارت خارجہ میں کروڑوں کی مالی بے ضابطگیوں کا انکشاف
stories.summary:
قومی اسمبلی کی پبلک اکاؤنٹس کمیٹی (پی اے سی) کے اجلاس میں مالی سال 24-2023 کے دوران وزارت خارجہ میں کروڑوں روپے کی مبینہ مالی بے ضابطگیوں کا انکشاف ہوا ہے۔ کمیٹی کے اجلاس کی صدارت نوید قمر نے کی، جس میں آسٹریا اور بلغاریہ کے پاکستانی سفارت خانوں میں اکاؤنٹنٹس کی جانب سے رقم کی خورد برد کے معاملات زیر غور لائے گئے۔

آڈٹ حکام نے کمیٹی کو بتایا کہ آسٹریا میں پاکستانی سفارت خانے کے اکاؤنٹنٹ سلمان قریشی نے مبینہ طور پر 16 کروڑ 56 لاکھ روپے یعنی ایک لاکھ 70 ہزار یورو خرد برد کیے اور رقم ذاتی اکاؤنٹس میں منتقل کی۔ سیکریٹری خارجہ عاصم افتخار نے بتایا کہ ملزم کو فوری برطرف کر کے مقدمہ درج کرا دیا گیا تھا اور وہ ضمانت پر رہا ہے۔ چیئرمین پی اے سی نے چھ سال گزرنے کے باوجود صرف ایف آئی آرز درج ہونے پر ایف آئی اے کی کارکردگی کو انتہائی مایوس کن قرار دیا۔

اجلاس میں بلغاریہ میں پاکستانی سفارت خانے کے اکاؤنٹنٹ کی جانب سے 2 کروڑ 90 لاکھ روپے کی خورد برد کا معاملہ بھی سامنے آیا۔ حکام نے بتایا کہ انکوائری کمیٹی کفایت شعاری اقدامات کی وجہ سے بیرون ملک نہیں جا سکی، جس پر کمیٹی نے انکوائری ٹیم کو بیرون ملک جانے کی اجازت دینے کی سفارش کی۔ مزید برآں، برلن میں پاکستانی سفارت خانے کی جانب سے ایچ ای سی کے اسکالرشپ فنڈ سے 10 کروڑ روپے قرض لینے اور ابوظہبی میں نجی کمیونٹی اسکول کو فنڈز کی ادائیگی کے معاملات پر بھی تفصیلی بحث کی گئی۔

سیکریٹری خارجہ نے وزارت کے افسران کے جوابات سے عدم اطمینان کا اظہار کیا۔ پی اے سی نے وزارت خارجہ کے مالی نظم و نسق پر گہری تشویش ظاہر کرتے ہوئے مستقبل میں ایسے واقعات کی روک تھام کے لیے واضح قواعد و ضوابط بنانے کی سخت ہدایت کی۔

stories.title: عبدل السید مشیگن سے سینیٹ کے پہلے مسلمان رکن منتخب
stories.summary:
امریکہ میں منگل کو ہونے والے انتخابات کے بعد مشیگن ریاست سے ڈیموکریٹک پارٹی کے امیدوار عبدل السید کامیاب ہو کر پہلے مسلمان سینیٹر بن گئے ہیں۔ حامیوں سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے اپنی کامیابی کو سراہا اور کہا کہ وہ ریاست مشیگن کی خدمت کے منتظر ہیں۔

انتخابی مہم کے آخری دنوں میں انہیں اپنی ہی جماعت کی رکن ہیلی سٹیونز کی جانب سے چیلنج کا سامنا کرنا پڑا جنہوں نے ریپبلکن امیدوار مائیک راجرز کی حمایت کی تھی۔ تاہم تمام تر چیلنجز کے باوجود السید انتخابات میں کامیابی حاصل کرنے میں کامیاب رہے۔

1984 میں ڈیٹرائٹ کے مضافات میں پیدا ہونے والے عبدل السید نے یونیورسٹی آف مشیگن اور کولمبیا یونیورسٹی سے طب کی تعلیم حاصل کی۔ وہ 2015 میں ڈیٹرائٹ سٹی کے محکمہ صحت کے ایگزیکٹو سربراہ رہے ہیں اور 2018 میں مشیگن کے گورنر کے پرائمری انتخابات میں حصہ لے چکے ہیں۔

ان کی انتخابی مہم صحت، معاشی عدم مساوات اور انتخابی اصلاحات کے گرد گھومتی تھی۔ صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ نے ان کی مہم کے دوران ان پر شدید تنقید کی اور انہیں کمیونسٹ قرار دیا جبکہ السید نے ان تمام الزامات کی تردید کی۔

stories.title: Abdul El-Sayed Wins Michigan Senate Seat as First Muslim US Senator
stories.summary:
Abdul El-Sayed won election to the United States Senate by defeating Republican candidate Mike Rogers in Michigan, marking a historic milestone as the first Muslim ever elected to the US Senate. At 42 years old, the Egyptian-American physician, public health expert, and progressive Democrat previously directed the Wayne County Department of Health in Michigan and ran for governor in 2018. His campaign focused on progressive issues including Medicare for All healthcare reform, economic inequality, reducing wealthy donor influence, and cutting overseas military spending.

The victory carries profound significance due to the intense political and Islamophobic scrutiny El-Sayed faced during his campaign. Donald Trump repeatedly attacked him by labeling him a 'jihadist' and invoking the September 11 attacks to question his national loyalty, while other Republicans falsely linked him to the Muslim Brotherhood. El-Sayed rejected these accusations, affirmed his commitment to the US Constitution, and maintained that American democracy must embrace citizens of all backgrounds. His grassroots movement successfully overcame heavy opposition spending, including funding from pro-Israel lobbying groups during the Democratic primary.

For millions of American Muslims, El-Sayed's election provides vital political representation, transforming community members and voters into national lawmakers and decision-makers. It challenges long-standing prejudices that attempt to paint Muslims as security threats or outsiders to American public life. Internationally, his win resonates deeply across the Middle East, North Africa, and South Asia, drawing attention due to his outspoken criticism of unconditional US military aid to Israel.

While his victory does not instantly alter Washington foreign policy or eradicate domestic Islamophobia, it fundamentally reshapes the conversation surrounding religious diversity and political inclusion in American democracy.

stories.title: Virat Kohli's Brilliant Half-Century Leads India to Victory Over New Zealand
stories.summary:
Virat Kohli hit an unbeaten 74 to guide India to a five-wicket triumph against New Zealand in the opening one-day international at Eden Park in Auckland on Wednesday. Turning 38 on Thursday, the veteran batsman struck his 80th ODI fifty from just 35 balls on a quick, bouncy pitch where other batters struggled, finishing his 51-ball knock with 13 fours and a six. India successfully chased a Duckworth-Lewis-adjusted target of 143 runs in 32 overs with 56 balls remaining, claiming a 1-0 lead in the five-match series.

New Zealand won the toss and batted first after rain caused a brief ten-minute delay to the start. The hosts were restricted to 185 all out in the 41st innings, with Tim Seifert top-scoring with 38 after replacing the concussed Devon Conway. Glenn Phillips contributed 30 runs, Daryl Mitchell added 28, and Blair Tickner made a quick 34 from 23 deliveries at the end of the innings. Indian bowlers Arshdeep Singh and Gurnoor Brar performed exceptionally, capturing 4-70 and 3-44 respectively to dismantle the New Zealand batting lineup.

India's chase suffered an early setback when captain Rohit Sharma was dismissed for a duck in the first over. However, Kohli anchored the innings alongside Shubman Gill, who contributed 37 runs from 56 balls during a crucial 113-run partnership. Rain interruptions temporarily halted play during the 11th and 12th overs before revised targets were established. Jacob Duffy picked up three wickets for New Zealand, but Kohli's aggressive strokeplay swiftly sealed the win.

The victory gives India an early advantage in the five-game series, with the second match scheduled to take place in Wellington on Saturday.

stories.title: Gold Prices Surge Sharply Across Pakistan Markets
stories.summary:
Gold prices recorded a significant increase across Pakistan on Wednesday, according to figures released by the All Pakistan Sarafa Gems and Jewellers Association. The cost of 24 karat per tola experienced a surge of Rs13,900, bringing the rate to Rs426,003. Additionally, the price for 22 karat per 10 grams went up by Rs11,917 to reach Rs365,257.

On the global front, gold rose by approximately $139 to settle around $4,035 per ounce. This upward movement contrasts with a previous gain of Rs2,400 earlier in the week, though prices remain well below the peaks seen in March 2026 when the metal traded near Rs541,000 per tola. Meanwhile, silver showed more volatility, dropping on Tuesday in response to softer international rates and varying industrial demand.

Market participants note that domestic bullion prices remain tightly linked to international rates and the exchange rate between the Pakistani rupee and the US dollar. Local price movements are often driven by a weaker global dollar, while factors like wedding-season demand and investments continue to influence intra-day quotations despite high absolute price levels.

Looking ahead, dealers and analysts are closely monitoring forthcoming US economic data, Federal Reserve policies, and global geopolitical developments for future market directions. Following recent rallies in gold and a decline in silver, the market remains in a period of consolidation after experiencing substantial price swings throughout 2026.

stories.title: Union Town in Lahore Achieves Major Development Milestones
stories.summary:
Union Town, an LDA-approved master-planned community developed by Union Developers (Pvt.) Limited in Lahore, has completed major infrastructure works within six months of record-breaking progress. The project features residential and commercial plots that are now fully developed and ready for immediate possession for interested buyers.

The community benefits from a strategic location in urban Lahore with triple access points via Kadir Topbas Chowk, Abdul Sattar Edhi Road, and Khayaban-e-Jinnah. Key nearby landmarks include the M2 Motorway and Shaukat Khanum Hospital, which are reachable within minutes, alongside the Lahore Ring Road and Canal Road.

A central feature of the development is the 150-feet-wide Pine Avenue, operating as a signal-free corridor running directly through the community to connect every block. Completed infrastructure works across the property include internal road networks, streetlights, an installed sewerage system, and community parks.

According to Naeem Ahmad Malik, CEO of Union Developers, the project embodies the company's vision of delivering a quality lifestyle through modern infrastructure and thoughtful planning. The development offers residential plots ranging from 3 to 20 Marla and commercial plots from 2 to 10 Marla to accommodate diverse lifestyle and investment needs.

stories.title: Trump-Backed Senate Candidates Suffer Major Defeats in Midterm Elections
stories.summary:
President Donald Trump's hand-picked Republican Senate candidates faced widespread defeats in the midterm elections, handing control of Congress to the Democrats and revealing the limits of the president's political influence. Trump had urged voters to view him as being on the ballot and intervened in key primaries to favor loyalists over established candidates with stronger local networks. High inflation driven by tariffs and the ongoing war in Iran contributed to voter frustration, while Reuters/Ipsos polls indicated Trump's popularity had dropped below levels seen after the January 6, 2021, Capitol attack.

In South Carolina, a state Trump won in 2024 and which had not elected a Democratic senator since 1998, Trump-backed Darline Graham lost to Democrat Annie Andrews. In North Carolina, former national Republican campaign official Michael Whatley was defeated by former Democratic Governor Roy Cooper after incumbent Republican Senator Thom Tillis declined to seek re-election following a public dispute with Trump. Independent analysts noted that Trump's intervention in the Texas primary cost Republicans a safe seat, as scandal-plagued Attorney General Ken Paxton lost to Democrat James Talarico instead of safer primary choice Senator John Cornyn. Meanwhile, former Representative Mike Rogers lost in Michigan to Democrat Abdul El-Sayed, who made history as the first Muslim elected to the United States Senate.

Strategists and former officials offered mixed reactions to the outcome, with veteran Republican strategist Doug Heye describing the results as a "Trump Quake" driven by economic and foreign policy concerns. Former North Carolina Governor Pat McCrory argued that the president's primary interventions fractured state Republican parties and eroded his connection with working-class voters. Despite internal White House polling from six weeks prior indicating projected losses in both the House and Senate, Trump defended his actions on social media, writing that he would have won in a landslide if he had personally been on the ballot.

White House officials defended the administration's efforts, noting that the president actively campaigned nationwide to salvage Republican chances after seeing grim internal polling data. Independent observers like American University professor Thomas Kahn emphasized that the strategic miscalculations in states like Texas and North Carolina directly handed secure seats over to the Democratic Party. The sweeping Democratic victories ultimately reshaped the congressional landscape and triggered intense debate within the Republican Party regarding Trump's ongoing role and political strategy moving forward.

stories.title: Scott Parker Appointed as New West Ham Manager
stories.summary:
Scott Parker has returned to West Ham United as the club's new manager on Wednesday, signing a two-and-a-half-year contract. The 46-year-old former England midfielder aims to lead the Championship side back to the Premier League following their recent relegation.

During his playing career, Parker made 129 appearances for West Ham between 2007 and 2011, serving as team captain. As a manager, he brings extensive experience in securing promotion from the second tier, having previously guided Fulham in 2020, Bournemouth in 2022, and Burnley in 2025 to the top flight.

Parker steps into the role to replace Nuno Espirito Santo, who was dismissed after consecutive defeats left the club in eighth place in the standings. Nuno had taken charge of a struggling West Ham squad in September 2025 but was unable to prevent the team's first relegation since 2011.

Expressing pride in his return, Parker described the opportunity as a chance to lead the club back to the Premier League. He most recently managed Burnley, departing by mutual consent in April shortly after the club's relegation back to the Championship.

stories.title: UN Women Honours Seventeen Businesses and Leaders at Pakistan WEPs Awards
stories.summary:
UN Women has recognized 17 businesses and leaders for advancing gender equality during the 2026 Women’s Empowerment Principles Awards in Pakistan. Selected from 52 nationwide applicants across seven categories, the honorees include major corporations as well as small and medium-sized enterprises. The event was organized by UN Women Pakistan in collaboration with Derien and Soorty, with Geo News serving as the media partner.

During the ceremony, UN Women Pakistan Country Representative Jamshed M. Kazi emphasized that business success is measured by the lives transformed and the futures made possible when women lead without barriers. Sindh Local Government Minister Syed Nasir Hussain Shah, the chief guest, noted that women's economic participation is vital for national progress. Nishat Fatima, CEO of South Air and keynote speaker, added that empowering women strengthens organizations and drives innovation.

The awards celebrated inclusive leadership, gender-responsive business practices, inclusive procurement, and the role of technology and artificial intelligence in promoting gender equality. National winners will be considered for the regional 2026 Asia-Pacific WEPs Awards, which will be broadcast on December 1, 2026, via the UN Women Asia-Pacific YouTube channel.

Marking the first national WEPs ceremony in Pakistan, the event underscored the importance of moving beyond paper commitments to real workplace and market changes. UN Women, the leading United Nations entity for gender equality, aims to transform laws, institutions, and social norms to close the global gender gap.

stories.title: SSGC Releases Winter Gas Supply Schedule for Consumers
stories.summary:
The Sui Southern Gas Company (SSGC) has officially announced its gas supply schedule for the winter season, establishing fixed time slots to prioritize domestic consumers during cooking hours. The measures follow directives issued by the Government of Pakistan to manage utility challenges.

Under the newly released schedule, gas will be supplied to households during three specific periods each day. Supplies will be available for breakfast from 6:30 am to 9:00 am, for lunch from 12:00 pm to 2:30 pm, and for dinner from 6:00 pm to 9:00 pm.

SSGC operates as one of the primary gas utilities in Pakistan, managing transmission and distribution across the Sindh and Balochistan provinces. The company maintains an extensive network of approximately 55,000 kilometres, providing natural gas to 3.2 million customers, which includes 4,500 industrial clients.

Historically, the utility has encountered significant operational hurdles. These challenges include unfinalized financial statements spanning several years, accumulating corporate losses, high levels of Unaccounted-for-Gas line losses, and mounting inter-enterprise liabilities that contribute to sector-wide circular debt.

stories.title: Indian Rupee Closes Slightly Higher as US Midterm Results Weaken Dollar
stories.summary:
The Indian currency concluded trading on Wednesday with a modest gain, moving to 94.64 per dollar compared to the prior session's finish of 94.74. This upward movement was supported by a softer American dollar and decreased oil costs as market participants evaluated the outcome of the United States midterm elections. The greenback's index dropped 0.4 percent to land at 101.3, with strong performances from the euro, Swiss franc, and sterling. During early trading hours, the rupee reached a two-week peak before paring gains due to increased interbank and importer dollar purchases near the 94.50 threshold.

Political developments in the US saw Democrats secure majorities in both the House and Senate following sweeping electoral wins across Republican strongholds, delivering a severe rebuke to President Donald Trump. Despite the rupee's temporary boost, a Reuters survey indicates that expectations for depreciation in the South Asian currency remain unchanged. Analysts project that the unit will surrender its recent advances and decline in the coming months amid a volatile external environment, ongoing high oil prices, and weak portfolio inflows.

The Reserve Bank of India has implemented multiple measures since the onset of the Iran conflict, including heavy intervention, restricted currency markets, higher interest rates, and raising roughly $143 billion via a borrowing and deposit scheme. According to financial firm Natixis, these actions successfully averted a disorderly collapse and provided temporary relief, but they fail to tackle the underlying causes of weakness. The note emphasized that central banks cannot manufacture export capacity, energy independence, or manufacturing investment, asserting that only structural reforms can address these fundamental issues.

stories.title: پنجاب کو تین یا چار انتظامی صوبوں میں تقسیم کیا جائے، خالد اصغر گھرال
stories.summary:
پاکستان مسلم لیگ (ق) کے رہنما اور پنجاب اسمبلی کے رکن چوہدری خالد اصغر گھرال نے گلاسگو میں ایک عشائیے سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ بہتر حکمرانی اور عوامی مسائل کے حل کے لیے چھوٹے صوبوں کا قیام ضروری ہو چکا ہے۔ انہوں نے تجویز دی کہ تیرہ کروڑ سے زائد آبادی والے صوبہ پنجاب کو تین یا چار انتظامی حصوں میں بانٹ دیا جائے۔

تقریب کے دوران گفتگو کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے مولانا فضل الرحمٰن کی موجودہ سیاسی سرگرمیوں پر تنقید کی اور انہیں افسوس ناک قرار دیا۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ بلوچستان اور خیبر پختون خوا میں سیکیورٹی کی خراب صورتِ حال کی وجہ سے تمام سیاسی جماعتوں کو قومی مفاد میں مشترکہ مؤقف اپنانا چاہیے اور ریاستی اداروں کا ساتھ دینا چاہیے۔

بیرونِ ملک مقیم پاکستانیوں کی خدمات کو سراہتے ہوئے انہوں نے کہا کہ وہ اپنی محنت اور دیانت کی بدولت دنیا بھر میں نمایاں مقام رکھتے ہیں اور سالانہ چالیس ارب ڈالرز سے زائد زرمبادلہ پاکستان بھیج کر معیشت کو سہارا دیتے ہیں۔ اس موقع پر چوہدری احسن گھرال نے بھی اظہارِ خیال کیا کہ وطن واپسی پر سمندر پار پاکستانیوں کو ایئر پورٹس پر ہراسانی کا سامنا کرنا پڑتا ہے۔

تقریب کے میزبان چوہدری طارق گوندل نے کہا کہ حکومت کو اوورسیز پاکستانیوں کو تحفظ دینا چاہیے تاکہ وہ اربوں ڈالرز کی سرمایہ کاری کر سکیں۔ چوہدری خالد اصغر گھرال نے شرکاء کو یقین دلایا کہ وہ تارکینِ وطن کے مسائل متعلقہ حکام کے سامنے اٹھائیں گے تاکہ ان کا ازالہ ممکن ہو سکے۔

stories.title: Shaza Fatima Khawaja Wins Prestigious Global Industry Champion of the Year Award
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Information Technology Shaza Fatima Khawaja has been honored with the international 'Industry Champion of the Year 2026' title at the Fastmode Awards 2026. She secured the global accolade after competing against more than 500 corporations spanning over 60 countries. This distinction is awarded annually to just a single leader worldwide, highlighting notable progress within Pakistan's information technology and IT-enabled services sector under her administration.

Under Khawaja's leadership, the nation's IT and ITeS exports reached a record-breaking $4.6 billion throughout the 2025-26 fiscal year. Furthermore, the sector achieved a trade surplus amounting to $3.9 billion, making it the top-performing segment among all services sectors in the country. Freelance export revenues totaled $1.76 billion, while active and registered freelancers surpassed 2.37 million. Additional milestones included completing Pakistan's largest-ever 5G and Next Generation Mobile Services spectrum auction in March 2026, expanding total available spectrum to 750 megahertz, and becoming the first Asian nation to entirely eliminate right-of-way charges for faster fibre-optic expansion.

Additional digital achievements involve Google registering and establishing its inaugural office in Pakistan alongside a local assembly line capable of producing 600,000 Chromebooks annually. The DigiSkills initiative delivered free digital training to over 4.5 million young individuals, including 800,000 women. Additionally, the GSMA reported a drop in the mobile internet gender gap from 38 percent to 8 percent, and the country climbed 27 places in the International Telecommunication Union's ICT Development Index 2026.

stories.title: Jennifer Lawrence Quotes Katniss Everdeen to Encourage US Midterm Voting
stories.summary:
Oscar-winning actress Jennifer Lawrence utilized her iconic 'The Hunger Games' character, Katniss Everdeen, to motivate American citizens to participate in the 2026 US midterm elections. On Tuesday, November 3, Lawrence posted a photo on her Instagram Stories showing her making the franchise's recognizable three-finger salute. She added a caption quoting a famous line from the 2014 film 'The Hunger Games: Mockingjay – Part 1' alongside a link to Vote.org to help her 8.7 million followers find polling locations.

In her social media post, Lawrence wrote, "Midterms bb. Don’t forget who burns with us. Go vote." The phrasing referenced Katniss's defiant speech to President Snow after a district hospital bombing, where the character declared that fire catches and burns back. Although the actress did not explicitly endorse any political candidate or party, the reference drew significant political interpretation from fans.

The public encouragement comes after Lawrence previously discussed her hesitation about using her celebrity platform for political statements, noting in a 2025 New York Times interview that she wanted to avoid contributing to societal division. Lawrence is currently preparing to return as Katniss in the upcoming film 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping', directed by Francis Lawrence, which is scheduled for theatrical release on November 20, 2026.

stories.title: Sri Lanka Declares at 223-7 Following Solid Fifties Against PCB Patron’s XI
stories.summary:
Sri Lanka closed their first innings at 223-7 declared during a three-day warm-up match against the PCB Patron’s XI at the Oval Ground in Islamabad on Wednesday. Winning the toss and opting to bat first, the visiting side struggled early on as opposing pacers effectively utilized morning moisture to trouble the top order. Quick breakthroughs by Saqib Khan and Mohammad Salman reduced Sri Lanka to 40-3, removing openers Pasindu Sooriyabandara, Dinesh Chandimal, and Dhananjaya De Silva in rapid succession.

In response to the early collapse, captain Kusal Mendis and opening batsman Lahiru Udara steadied the innings through a crucial 90-run partnership for the fourth wicket. Udara anchored the recovery with a disciplined knock of 65 runs from 105 balls, hitting seven fours and three sixes before being caught off his own bowling by Ali Shabir. Shabir quickly claimed another wicket by dismissing Sunal Dinusha for 10, leaving the visitors struggling at 153-5.

Following the dismissal of Udara and Dinusha, Kusal Mendis found reliable support in Anjala Bandara, who contributed a valuable 45-run partnership for the sixth wicket. Kusal eventually fell to fast bowler Ubaid Shah after scoring a team-high 66 runs from 72 balls, featuring 11 boundaries. Following Kusal's dismissal, Bandara continued to anchor the crease and finished unbeaten on 33 runs from 61 balls, prompting the Sri Lankan captain to declare the innings at 223-7 to give his bowling attack an opportunity before stumps.

For the PCB Patron’s XI, Saqib Khan, Mohammad Salman, and Ali Shabir each claimed two wickets. In reply, the home side reached 43-2 in 15 overs before stumps, with Azan Awais batting on 19 and Mohammad Taha on 16 after early dismissals by Dilshan Madushanka and Rathnayake. The fixture serves as final preparation for Sri Lanka ahead of the upcoming two-match Test series against Pakistan, which is scheduled to commence at the Rawalidpindi Cricket Stadium on November 9.

stories.title: سوئی سدرن نے کراچی میں موسم سرما کے لیے گیس شیڈول جاری کر دیا
stories.summary: سوئی سدرن گیس کمپنی نے کراچی کے گھریلو صارفین کے لیے موسم سرما کے دوران گیس لوڈشیڈنگ کا نیا شیڈول جاری کر دیا ہے۔ اس نئے شیڈول کے تحت صارفین کو چوبیس گھنٹوں میں صرف تین مخصوص اوقات کار کے دوران ہی گیس کی فراہمی ممکن ہو سکے گی۔ کمپنی کے اعلامیے کے مطابق صبح کے وقت ناشتے کی تیاری کے لیے ساڑھے چھ بجے سے نو بجے تک، دوپہر کے کھانے کے لیے بارہ بجے سے ڈھائی بجے تک، اور شام کے وقت رات کے کھانے کے لیے چھ بجے سے نو بجے تک گیس مہیا کی جائے گی۔ شہریوں کو ہدایت دی گئی ہے کہ وہ اپنے روزمرہ کے کھانے پینے کے امور کو انہی مقررہ اوقات کے مطابق ترتیب دیں۔ کسی بھی قسم کی شکایت یا معلومات کے حصول کے لیے صارفین ہیلپ لائن نمبر 1199 پر رابطہ کر سکتے ہیں یا پھر سرکاری ویب سائٹ سے رجوع کر سکتے ہیں۔ دوسری طرف، عوام کی جانب سے اس شیڈول پر شدید تحفظات کا اظہار کیا گیا ہے۔ متاثرہ شہریوں کا کہنا ہے کہ کاغذی حد تک جاری ہونے والا یہ شیڈول عملی طور پر نافذ نہیں ہوتا، کیونکہ مقررہ وقت سے پہلے ہی گیس کی فراہمی معطل کر دی جاتی ہے اور گیس آنے کے وقت بھی تاخیر برتی جاتی ہے۔ اس صورتحال کی وجہ سے بیشتر علاقوں میں صبح ساڑھے چھ بجے کے بجائے سات بجے کے بعد گیس آتی ہے اور نو بجے سے پہلے ہی غائب ہو جاتی ہے، اور یہی بے قاعدگی دوپہر اور رات کے اوقات میں بھی برقرار رہتی ہے۔ اس بے قاعدگی کی وجہ سے بچوں کا ناشتہ، اسکول کا ٹفن اور رات کا کھانا بنانے کے معاملات سخت متاثر ہو رہے ہیں۔ ہر گھرانے کے لیے مہنگے ایل پی جی سلنڈر خریدنا ممکن نہیں ہے، اس لیے شہریوں نے سوئی سدرن گیس کمپنی سے پرزور مطالبہ کیا ہے کہ صرف شیڈول جاری کرنے پر اکتفا نہ کیا جائے بلکہ اس پر سختی سے عملدرآمد کو بھی یقینی بنایا جائے، اور جن علاقوں میں پریشر کم ہے یا گیس تاخیر سے پہنچتی ہے وہاں فوری بنیادوں پر ضروری اقدامات اٹھائے جائیں۔

stories.title: Mohammad Rizwan Hits Unbeaten Double Century in Quaid-e-Azam Trophy
stories.summary:
Peshawar Blues captain Mohammad Rizwan delivered an outstanding performance on Wednesday, scoring an unbeaten double century on the second day of the Quaid-e-Azam Trophy Gold tournament. Playing against Faisalabad at the Abbottabad Cricket Stadium, Rizwan finished the day with 200 not out off 391 balls, hitting 35 fours and a single six. His efforts propelled Peshawar to declare their first innings at 503-4.

Resuming their overnight score of 306-3, Rizwan shared a substantial partnership with Najab Khan, who contributed 133 runs with 25 boundaries and a six. Mohammad Haris added an unbeaten 70 late in the innings, while Faisalabad bowlers Asad Raza and Mudasar Zunair picked up two wickets each. In response, Faisalabad reached 118-2 by stumps, with Mohammad Adnan dismissing both Faham-ul-Haq and Sameer Saqif.

In other tournament matches across Islamabad, Lahore Whites were dismissed for 234 against FATA, where Hamza Aziz claimed six wickets. Karachi Blues were bowled out for 280 against Sialkot Blues, led by Muhammad Gazi Ghori's 88 runs. Meanwhile, Multan reached 249-7 against Islamabad to secure a 34-run lead, supported by Iram Rafiq's unbeaten 93 and Sharoon Siraj's 82.

stories.title: UK Supreme Court Hears Challenge Against Palestine Action Terrorist Designation
stories.summary:
A co-founder of Palestine Action appeared at the UK Supreme Court to contest the British government's classification of the campaign group as a terrorist organisation. Lawyers representing Huda Ammori argued that the proscription was disproportionate and misused counter-terrorism laws, pointing out that government officials had previously assessed that only three out of 385 actions over a five-year period met terrorism definitions. 

The British government officially proscribed the group last year following a series of escalating disruptions primarily aimed at defense companies. These incidents culminated in a break-in at the Royal Air Force's Brize Norton air base that resulted in damage to two aircraft, as well as a 2024 raid targeting Israeli defense firm Elbit Systems that caused an estimated £1 million ($1.35 million) in property damage. The Home Office maintained that these actions involved weapons and violence against police officers and security staff, including an incident where an officer suffered a spinal injury from a sledgehammer. 

The government ban has drawn substantial pushback from civil liberties organizations and public figures, including Irish novelist Sally Rooney, whose books were pulled from sale in Britain over royalty donations to the group. Home Office data indicates that more than 3,600 arrests linked to Palestine Action occurred between July 2025 and June, accounting for over a third of all UK terrorism arrests since 9/11. Following subsequent demonstrations outside the US embassy in London and outside the Supreme Court, the total number of arrests has now surpassed 4,000.
